fields.hero_lede: Lilavati Clinic & Wellness has cared for Ahmedabad patients for 32 years. It runs 50+ specialities with 50+ staff, and over 10,000 patients have passed through its consultations, diagnostics and speciality services.
fields.overview_heading: The Care Setup At Lilavati Clinic
fields.overview_content:
At Lilavati, diagnostics, imaging, physiotherapy and an in-house pharmacy sit alongside specialist consultations. In a single visit, a patient might see a doctor, get an investigation done, pick up a report, then use another service on the way out.

So the day only runs if teams stay in sync. The doctor needs earlier records to hand. The diagnostics team needs the exact test details. And the patient needs the prescription and report without a wait or a follow-up call.
fields.problem_heading: Where The Clinic Workflow Was Getting Stuck
fields.problem_intro: Four recurring workflows consumed staff time each day.

problems.title: Routine Requests
problems.text: After a visit, patients contacted the front desk for prescriptions, reports and follow-up details — around 120 calls a day, close to one full role spent on the phone.

problems.title: Follow-Up Calls
problems.text: Staff made reminder and follow-up calls. At a 21% no-show rate, nearly one in five specialist slots stayed empty, requiring the team to rearrange the day.

problems.title: Clinical Notes
problems.text: Each speciality had different documentation needs. Handwritten notes added minutes to each consult and made records harder to read across departments.

problems.title: Test Hand-Offs
problems.text: Test orders moved through several teams before reaching the lab, so staff had to confirm manually that each order had been received.

fields.decision_intro: Dr. Gunjan Desai shared how the team adapted after go-live.
fields.quote_text: The reminders changed our days; no-shows dropped from about a fifth of bookings to roughly one in eight, so specialists stopped losing slots. Training took two rounds for some of us, but the team stayed with us until it stuck.
fields.solution_intro: Healthray's clinic software now supports these workflows with connected digital tools.

solutions.title: Patient Portal
solutions.text: Prescriptions and reports now reach patients through the Healthray app, reducing routine calls and visits to the front desk.

solutions.title: Reminders
solutions.text: Automated reminders go out by WhatsApp, SMS and email, while the waitlist helps fill slots when appointments are cancelled.

solutions.title: EMR Templates
solutions.text: AI suggestions, auto-fill and voice-to-note help doctors document care faster, with clinician review of the final record.

solutions.title: Test Alerts
solutions.text: Orders are saved in the patient record, and the lab receives an alert as soon as a test is requested.

fields.setup_intro: Healthray's team completed three steps with the clinic before the system went live.

steps.title: Workflows Mapped
steps.text: Healthray specialists mapped the clinic's workflows and configured each module around how teams work.

steps.title: Records Moved
steps.text: 10,400 existing patient records were migrated so relevant history remained available to authorised teams.

steps.title: Teams Trained
steps.text: Training was tailored by role, allowing each team to practise the screens and tasks it uses.

fields.results_intro: Lilavati Clinic reported these results in the four months after rollout.

results.title: Saved Daily
results.text: Front-desk call time fell from about 3.5 hours to 1.5 hours, giving the team more time to support patients.

results.title: Fewer No-Shows
results.text: The no-show rate fell from 21% to 13%, helping specialists avoid unused appointment slots.

results.title: Records
results.text: More than 10,000 patient records are now available in speciality-specific formats.

results.title: Faster Reports
results.text: Report turnaround fell from about 26 hours to 13 hours after test orders were placed.
